Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Kevin and I are excited to get the POC rolling. We'd like to prioritize a hands-on prompt review workshop during the kickoff so we can align on:

- Prompt inventory and high-value flows
- Guardrails and safety checks (PII, hallucination thresholds)
- Structured output requirements (JSON schemas, field mappings)
- Routing & load test targets for the first week
